author: Mark Atwood
text:
Workspace-wide pattern check completed: 7 of 8 extension-server crates carry the duplicate-re-export shape (mail/chat/calendars/contacts/sharing/metadata/filenode — tasks-server differs). The fix requires canonical-first change to mail-server then propagate to the 6 siblings + tasks audit, exactly the kind of multi-crate sweep that AGENTS.md says must be a workspace epic.

This bead overlaps with JMAP-510h.39 (already deferred under JMAP-xbeb, the workspace propagation epic for trait + handler + re-export contract sweep). .39 asks 'should we re-export at all and how do we namespace'; .46 asks 'when we do re-export, how do we avoid the lib.rs+backend.rs duplication'. The two are complementary halves of the same re-export hygiene story and should land together to avoid two sweeps across the same code.

Recommendation: defer this bead under JMAP-xbeb alongside .39. When JMAP-xbeb decomposes into per-crate children, the per-crate re-export work merges the two concerns into a single edit per file pair (lib.rs + backend.rs).

Filing deferred (not human) per workspace AGENTS.md 'When NOT to file human' rule 2 — this is parked-backlog awaiting the human-decision step that was already taken (JMAP-xbeb was filed).
